title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Regigigas VSTAR Universe 123/172 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Japanese Pokémon 123/172 Regigigas s12a VSTAR Universe Holo Card is an amazing addition to any collector's set. With a fire attribute and dragon creature/monster type, this card features Regigigas, a powerful stage 2 Pokémon. The card is made of high-quality paper and has a holo finish, making it a valuable and unique addition to any collection. 

The card is part of the VSTAR Universe set and has a card number of 123/172. It is a standard size card and was manufactured by Nintendo in Japan in 2022. The card is in Japanese language and features artwork by Kouki Saito. It is suitable for ages 6+ and has a defense/toughness of 2 and an attack/power of 250. This card is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector or fan of Regigigas.
